title: ComparePeriods
description: Output of the MCP tool compare_periods. The MCP server calls GET /crew/{astronaut_id}/history twice (period A, period B) and computes this comparison; there is no HTTP endpoint for it. Every delta is B minus A (positive means B is higher than A; whether higher is better or worse depends on the feature). Absence is never good news: a missing value is null, never omitted and never 0. Check warnings before interpreting the numbers.

features.description: Features present in BOTH periods, one entry per (feature_id, protocol_id, gravity_environment). Only the same protocol and the same gravity are comparable, so they are part of the key.

only_in_a.description: Keys with data in period A only: the feature disappeared or was not measured in period B. Not a comparison.

only_in_b.description: Keys with data in period B only: the feature is new or was not measured in period A. Not a comparison.

scores.description: Mean of each assessment score per period, on [0, 1], and delta = b - a. A value is null when the period has no assessments (and delta is null if either side is null).

warnings.description: Reasons the comparison may be incomplete or misleading. period_a_empty / period_b_empty: the period has no data. period_a_truncated / period_b_truncated: the history had more items than the limit and only the most recent were used, so the period is partly missing. unit_mismatch: the same key had different units in the two periods and was left out of features.

period.description: One compared time window and how much data it had.

feature_sets_count.description: Feature sets found in the window.

truncated.description: True if the history was cut at its limit and only the most recent items were kept.

feature_key.description: Comparison key of a feature: values are comparable only with the same feature, protocol and gravity.

feature_stats.description: Statistics of one feature in one period, in the unit of the feature.

mean.description: Mean of the values, in the feature unit.

median.description: Median of the values, in the feature unit.

feature_comparison.description: One feature measured in both periods. delta = b - a, in the feature unit.

unit.description: Unit of every number of this entry (e.g. %, deg, mm, Hz).

delta_mean.description: b.mean - a.mean, in the feature unit.

delta_median.description: b.median - a.median, in the feature unit.

level_counts.description: Number of assessments per level in one period.

latest.description: Level of the most recent assessment of the period, or null when the period has no assessments.

score_comparison.description: Mean of a score in each period and delta = b - a. null when a period has no assessments.

delta.description: b - a, in [-1, 1]; null if a or b is null.
